summary: Complete Q1 Explore review of 112 finished with changes-requested. 112 correctly makes verificationSummaryRef Run-stable through context.changeId and gives it an Action-owned inclusion rule. That rule is still lifecycle-inverted: it requires apply and revise-apply to resolve verification.md before their terminal result can publish, while formal lifecycle and verification rules require Change Verification to execute after each of those Actions. A missing verification.md therefore holds the Action pending and prevents the verification that would create or update it. Archive is likewise made eligible despite its action moving Change artifacts to the archive path. The verification-reference eligibility set remains non-executable.

blockingFindings.title: verificationSummaryRef eligibility is ordered before the Verification it requires
blockingFindings.evidence: 112 declares apply, revise-apply, review-apply, and archive verification-eligible, and requires eligible Actions with missing verification.md to remain pending. The frozen lifecycle is apply → Change Verification → review-apply, and revise-apply → Change Verification → review-apply; verification-model.md also requires Change Verification after apply and revise-apply. Thus an apply or revise-apply Run cannot publish when verification.md is absent, yet the required verification cannot happen until that Action finishes. Archive is also eligible even though archival relocates Change artifacts from openspec/changes/<change-id>/ to the archive path, so its original-path resolver is not stable across the archive operation.
blockingFindings.impact: Normal first Apply and every revision can deadlock before Change Verification. Archive can similarly fail against a path its own action relocates. This contradicts the fixed lifecycle and prevents a deterministic implementation of the optional verification reference.
blockingFindings.requiredResolution: Keep Q1-RE-004 open. Set verificationSummaryRef eligibility only at a lifecycle point where the relevant verification record already exists and remains at the resolver's declared path—at minimum review-apply may consume the completed Change Verification record. Remove apply and revise-apply from automatic eligibility; they must complete before Verification runs. Either remove archive eligibility or define an archive-safe, immutable target/retention resolver after the formal artifact move; do not rely on the pre-archive path during archive completion. Update the inclusion, preflight, tests, acceptance, and cross-reference matrix for: first apply before verification, revised apply before re-verification, review-apply with passed/not-applicable verification, and archive relocation.

nonBlockingFindings.title: Explore source links remain checkout-specific
nonBlockingFindings.evidence: The cited code links use file:///D:/Projects/flowkit absolute paths and cannot resolve in another checkout or platform.
nonBlockingFindings.recommendedResolution: Use repository-relative Markdown links in a future in-scope Explore edit. This remains non-blocking because the cited source evidence was independently verified.

resolvedFindings.evidence: Core now fixes non-Run kind selection and uses an Action-bounded produced-artifact path mapping.
